activity_summary: After the third playing Garnish gave the tally as thirty-five lines in three days, and one whole song. You told him to say it and not to copy the lines into the book today. The company drank my lord's health and did not add his age. Heminges had the trestles stacked, and said they were the inn's. You heard a harder, hungrier edge in the lads' voices than in a cheap-bread year, and you did not answer them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Accepted the spoken tally, forbade a copying, and would not answer the yard.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Said the third time had held, and told you not to argue with the holiday.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Claimed the faces and the song, and lifted the trestle.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Ticked one whole song, said thirty-five, and kept the newest lines out of the play-book.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Gave the health without a number of years, and stacked the inn's trestles.

facets.activity: Heard thirty-five lines and one song

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: Thirty-five lines in three days, and one whole song.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: My lord's health. We drink it here, and we do not count the years at this table.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Say the tally. I am not copying the lines into the book today.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Stack the trestles. They are the inn's, not the company's.
